title: Jamaican Tamarind Chicken Tagine
description: A warm, indulgent, and flavorful dish from the heart of Jamaica, this chicken tagine is cooked to perfection with the rich flavors of tamarind.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from pot.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper (if using); cook for 1 minute.
Add tamarind paste; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return chicken to pot, cover, and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
